title: Control: the half-marathon week with a long run instead of a race
message: I need a meal plan for next week, {Mon} to {Sun}.
Tuesday: 55 min with 4 x 6 min at threshold
Saturday: 20 min easy jog with 4 strides
I weigh 62 kg and live in Australia. No restrictions. I've got half a bag of spinach and some Greek yoghurt to use up.
That's everything — please go ahead and make the plan.
